_meta.description: A photo editor for iPhone, iPad and Mac that matches the look of any photo you admire and hands it back as real adjustments. Curves, colour mixer, masks, retouching, culling — on device, non-destructive, inside Photos.
_title: Luma Editor — Match a Look. Keep Every Slider.

luma-groups-near-duplicates.86ae84: Luma groups near-duplicates and suggests the keeper by focus, open eyes and exposure. Picks go to a Luma Keepers album, and nothing is ever deleted.
luma-measures-how-the.16c5cd: Luma measures how the photo you picked actually looks — its tonal distribution, its colour balance, how it treats each family of hues, what it does in the shadows and the highlights — and then solves for the adjustments that move your photo there. The answer comes back as sliders, curves and a colour mixer you can go on editing, not as a finished picture.
luma-rebuilds-the-spot.cec564: Luma rebuilds the spot from the texture around it. Each repair stays an adjustment you can move or remove a month later.
match-a-look-keep.1134b2: Match a Look. Keep Every Slider.
nine-every-screen-and.115f6b: Nine. Every screen, and the App Store listing, is in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian, and Luma follows the language your device is set to.
no-luma-edits-non.7d9ff4: No. Luma edits non-destructively through the Photos library: your original file is never touched, Revert to Original always works, edits sync through iCloud Photos, and reopening a photo in Luma restores every slider exactly where you left it rather than starting again from the rendered result.
pick-a-few-photos.bd1306: Pick a few photos as your styles, then develop a whole shoot at once. Luma matches each picture to the style that suits it best.
show-luma-a-photograph.785bbb: Show Luma a photograph whose look you love. It brings yours there as real adjustments, not a filter.

when-both-apps-are.c7b315: When both apps are installed, Luma's Retouch tab offers Remove Something in Ari. Luma sends the untouched photo to Ari's Photo Studio, you remove what you need with Ari's on-device models, and Save to Luma Editor brings you back with the object gone and your grade still applied. Luma itself never invents content; that part happens in Ari, where it is visible.
which-languages-does-luma.f32b8f: Which languages does Luma Editor speak?
yes-export-any-look.854137: Yes. Export any look as a 3D LUT (.cube) for video work, as Adobe Camera Raw settings for Lightroom, or as JSON.
yes-from-the-photos.40ae4a: Yes, from the Photos editing screen. Open a clip, tap Edit, then the extensions button, then Luma, and the framing, tone, colour, curves, colour mixer and gradient and range masks all apply to every frame. Content-aware masks are left out of motion — a segmentation recomputed per frame visibly crawls, and approximating it would look worse than not offering it.
yes-luma-editor-is.3b1eca: Yes. Luma Editor is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
